{{DISPLAYTITLE:vaspin.h5}}
This file can be used to replace the typical {{FILE|INCAR}}, {{FILE|POSCAR}}, {{FILE|POTCAR}}, and {{FILE|KPOINTS}} files using a single HDF5 file.

Currently, we do not provide a tool to systematically create this file from scratch, instead, this feature is currently mostly intended to reproduce previous calculations.

A {{FILE|vaspout.h5}} file that resulted from previous calculations can be renamed to {{FILE|vaspin.h5}}, copied to an empty directory, and used as input for a new VASP run.
